bandReport.notes:
Clean seams both ends. p05 (not mine) ends with Q33 complete, all four options printed; p06 opens with Q34 complete. p08 ends with Q53 complete; p09 (not mine) opens with Q54. No question straddles either seam.

NO Directions / 'Consider the following for the next N items' block anywhere in p05-p09 — every question in this band is standalone. Q45, Q49 and Q52 open 'Consider the following statements :' but each is a single self-contained item with its own four options, not a shared-stimulus set.

NO printed figure anywhere in p06-p08. Q48 describes a triangle inscribed in a semicircle purely in words; nothing is drawn. hasFigure is therefore absent on every question.

Layout is two-column throughout: LEFT column top-to-bottom then RIGHT. p06 = Q34-37 left, Q38-40 right. p07 = Q41-43 left, Q44-47 right. p08 = Q48-50 left, Q51-53 right.

The booklet prints the rupee glyph; Q40 is transcribed as 'Rs.' per the brief. The booklet prints raised middle dots for decimals (78·40, 122·50, 0·301, 0·477, 5·5, 6·5); transcribed as full stops per the brief.

All exponents, radicands, fraction extents and option texts on this band were checked against 8-9x crops of the source PDF, not read off the 2.6x page render.

questions.stem: What is the value of \(\dfrac{a^2 + ac}{a^2c - c^3} - \dfrac{a^2 - c^2}{a^2c + 2ac^2 + c^3} - \dfrac{2c}{a^2 - c^2} + \dfrac{3}{a + c}\) ?
What is the square root of \(4x^4 + 8x^3 - 4x + 1\) ?
flags: Stem verified at 9x: the quartic as printed carries no \(x^2\) term at all — it reads \(4x^4 + 8x^3 - 4x + 1\), with the \(x^3\) term followed directly by \(-4x\). Transcribed exactly as printed; noted only because a missing middle term is the kind of thing a later reader might assume was dropped in transcription.

questions.stem: The sum of the digits of a two digit number is 13 and the difference between the number and that formed by reversing the digits is 27. What is the product of the digits of the number ?
If \(\dfrac{x}{b + c} = \dfrac{y}{c + a} = \dfrac{z}{b - a}\), then which one of the following is correct ?
flags: Possible typesetting error, transcribed as printed: the third denominator is printed \(b - a\). Checked at 9x — the sign between b and a is unambiguously a minus and the letter order is b then a. The two preceding denominators are the cyclic \(b + c\) and \(c + a\), so a cyclic third term would read \(a + b\). Not repaired.

questions.stem: A car did a journey in t hours. Had the average speed been x kmph greater, the journey would have taken y hours less. How long was the journey ?
flags: Possible wording error, transcribed as printed: the stem asks 'How long was the journey ?' while the journey time t is already given in the stem, and every option is an algebraic expression in x, t and y rather than a time. All four options and the stem were checked at 8x and are exactly as reproduced. Not repaired.

questions.stem: When a ball is allowed to fall, the time it takes to fall any distance varies as the square root of the distance and it takes 4 seconds to fall 78.40 m. How long would it take to fall 122.50 m ?
If \(6^{3 - 4x}\, 4^{x + 5} = 8\) (Given \(\log_{10} 2 = 0.301\) and \(\log_{10} 3 = 0.477\)), then which one of the following is correct ?
flags: Exponents verified at 8x: the first factor is \(6\) raised to \(3 - 4x\) and the second is \(4\) raised to \(x + 5\); the two factors are juxtaposed with no printed multiplication sign.
